name: Nagar Nigam Srinagar
jurisdiction: Srinagar municipal corporation area, Pauri Garhwal district, Uttarakhand
description: Srinagar Garhwal's municipal corporation is listed separately from Nagar Nigam Kotdwar in Pauri Garhwal district. The 2024-25 election register records 40 wards. This is not the municipal corporation in Jammu and Kashmir.
